title: feat(studio): collapsible right-side AI Chat panel (VS Code style)
body:
Adds a global floating AI Chat panel to Studio, docked to the right edge. Collapsed: 48px edge button. Expanded: 380px panel with streaming chat via Vercel AI SDK.

### New files

- **`components/AiChatPanel.tsx`** — Panel UI with header, scrollable message list, text input. Uses `@ai-sdk/react` `useChat` + `DefaultChatTransport` pointed at `/api/v1/ai/chat`. Renders `UIMessage.parts[]` (AI SDK v6 format). Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline.
- **`hooks/use-ai-chat-panel.ts`** — Panel open/close state + message history persisted to localStorage. Global keyboard shortcut `Ctrl+Shift+I` / `Cmd+Shift+I`. Uses functional state updates to avoid stale closures in the keydown handler.
- **`test/ai-chat-panel.test.tsx`** — 9 tests covering `loadMessages`/`saveMessages` edge cases (empty, invalid JSON, quota exceeded), panel state keys, and toggle behavior.

### Modified files

- **`App.tsx`** — Mounts `<AiChatPanel />` inside `<SidebarProvider>`, alongside left sidebar
- **`package.json`** — Adds `ai@^6.0.142`, `@ai-sdk/react@^3.0.144`

### API surface

```tsx
// Hook API
const { isOpen, setOpen, toggle } = useAiChatPanel();

// Chat uses AI SDK v6 transport pattern (not legacy v2 api string)
const transport = new DefaultChatTransport({ api: '/api/v1/ai/chat' });
const { messages, sendMessage, status } = useChat({ transport, messages: initialMessages });
```

### localStorage keys

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| `objectstack:ai-chat-messages` | `UIMessage[]` JSON |
| `objectstack:ai-chat-panel-open` | `"true"` / `"false"` |
